name: Larp Buttons
description: Adds a bunch of useless buttons to the pause menu. Every one can be switched off.

enable-pulse.name: Upside-Down Pulse Trigger
enable-pulse.description: Far left of the pause menu. Toggles "reverse pulse mode" and plays the chest sound.

enable-verity.name: Verity
enable-verity.description: Far left of the pause menu. Shows "verity mode: enabled" with a cool down.

enable-refresh.name: Refresh Nothing
enable-refresh.description: Far left of the pause menu. Spins for 2 seconds and does nothing.

enable-vault.name: Locked Vault
enable-vault.description: Far left of the pause menu. Says "key required!" and plays a sound.

enable-zucchini.name: ZucchiniV2 Checkbox
enable-zucchini.description: Far right of the pause menu. A checkbox that does nothing.

enable-pause-center.name: Pause Center Button
enable-pause-center.description: Below the continue button. Clicking it exits the level.

enable-do-better-like.name: Do Better Like
enable-do-better-like.description: Far right of the pause menu. A like button that takes you to the Do Better level.

enable-mirror-portal.name: Reverse Mirror Portal
enable-mirror-portal.description: Main menu, above the daily chests. Pops up a "hello" box at the bottom.

enable-death.name: Death
enable-death.description: Pause menu, above the practice mode button. Returns to the level and kills you.

enable-r4ndoom.name: R4ndoom Button
enable-r4ndoom.description: Far right of the pause menu. Opens the profile of r4ndoom.

enable-dice.name: Volume Dice
enable-dice.description: Pause menu, under the music slider. The dice randomizes the music volume; "Both?" randomizes music and SFX.

enable-easy-face.name: Easy Face Button
enable-easy-face.description: Main menu, bottom row. A button with the easy face that does nothing.

enable-continue-info.name: Continue Info Button
enable-continue-info.description: Pause menu, top right of the continue button. Opens a popup about the button.

enable-2-3-checkbox.name: 2.3 Checkbox
enable-2-3-checkbox.description: Level page, far left. A checkbox that does nothing.

enable-empty-button.name: Empty Button
enable-empty-button.description: Level page, far left. A blank button that does nothing.

enable-rate-level.name: Rate Level Button
enable-rate-level.description: Level page, beneath the play button. Shows "Rated!" when clicked.

enable-butter.name: Butter Button
enable-butter.description: Search page, next to the X. Opens a profile.

fixed-left-column.name: Fixed Left Column
fixed-left-column.description: Off (default): left-side pause buttons join the game's left button column, like other mods. On: put them at a fixed spot instead.

left-column-x.name: Fixed Column Position
left-column-x.description: Only used when Fixed Left Column is on. Distance from the left edge.

use-orb-sprite.name: Use Game Sprite For Black Orb
use-orb-sprite.description: Turn this off to draw the black orb yourself if the game sprite shows up as a pink checkerboard.

enable-black-orb.name: Black Orb
enable-black-orb.description: Far left of the pause menu. A black orb with an X that toggles to a check.
